brain.commentary: Broad risk-on regime is offset by weak marginal composites, modest conviction, negative alpha for ETH/SOL/LTC, and a shared institutional advisory risk score. Maintain reduced exposure rather than leaning into the nominal long bias. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile because zero volatility, expected shortfall, and liquidity fields suggest missing or unreliable risk data; their long signals should not receive full sizing.
